remplacements.raison: On garde l’idée des plaids assortis, mais on l’ancre dans le mécanisme autorisé du projet : personnalisation prénom + couleur.
La promesse que les enfants les adorent n’est pas prouvée pour ce produit. Elle est remplacée par un bénéfice autorisé, concret et non chiffré : chaque enfant reconnaît son plaid comme le sien.

plan.prompt:
Using image 1 as the MASTER layout, composition, family scene, pose, couch placement, Christmas tree background, lighting and framing reference, and image 2 as the PRIMARY product and brand identity reference for Plaid à Moi.

GLOBAL LOCK:
Change ONLY the specific elements explicitly listed below. Everything else must remain visually consistent with image 1.

STRUCTURE LOCK:
Keep the same 4:5 vertical ad composition as image 1. Keep the cozy living room setting, beige couch, window on the left, Christmas tree in the background, warm natural daylight, soft holiday atmosphere, and the same overall camera distance and angle. Keep four children sitting side by side on the couch, wrapped in personalized blankets, with the blankets covering most of the lower half of the image. Keep the headline text box in the same upper area, centered horizontally, with rounded corners, soft pale background, dark text, and mobile-friendly readability. Keep the same emotional energy: cozy, happy, family, giftable, warm, and personal.

MODEL TRANSFORMATION RULE:
The children must be clearly different people from image 1. Keep the same general arrangement, seated poses, playful expressions, cozy posture, and group energy, but use different faces, different hair, and visibly different individual appearances. Do not recreate the exact children from image 1.

TEXT STYLE LOCK:
Keep the same text hierarchy, large bold headline style, rounded text box treatment, centered alignment, strong mobile readability, and similar spacing as image 1. The WORDS may change only where explicitly listed below.

PRODUCT IDENTITY LOCK:
The final blankets must unmistakably represent Plaid à Moi using image 2 as the primary product and brand identity reference. Preserve the real blanket look, fabric texture, softness, border treatment, colors, name personalization style, pattern style, brand colors, and any visible legitimate brand details from image 2. Do not redesign the product beyond adapting it naturally into the image 1 composition. The blankets should look like soft personalized children's plaids, each with a different color and a repeated first name pattern. The names are demonstration examples only, not real customer results.

VISUAL CHANGE 1:
Change ONLY the competitor blankets FROM the four personalized blankets in image 1 TO Plaid à Moi personalized blankets based on image 2. Keep each child wrapped in one blanket, with the same blanket coverage, folds, cozy volume, and couch placement. Use four distinct child-friendly blanket colors inspired by the brand and product reference: soft pink, blue, green, and purple. Keep the white cozy trim or soft edge treatment if consistent with the product reference. Maintain realistic fleece texture, natural folds, and soft shadows.

VISUAL CHANGE 2:
Change ONLY the visible blanket names FROM the competitor-style names in image 1, including Chloe, Daniel, Olivia, and Sophia, TO the demonstration names Léa, Noah, Emma, and Zoé. Place each name repeatedly across its own blanket in a handwritten-style personalization pattern, similar in visual rhythm to image 1, but matched to the Plaid à Moi product identity from image 2. The names must be readable but naturally integrated into the blanket fabric, following folds and perspective.

VISUAL CHANGE 3:
Change ONLY the top headline text FROM:
"Yhteensopivat huovat tulivat... ja lapset RAKASTAVAT niitä! 😍"
TO:
"Son prénom. Sa couleur. Son plaid à lui. 😍"
Keep the headline in French. Keep the same approximate number of lines, same upper text box placement, same rounded rectangle background, same bold friendly font feel, and strong contrast. Do not add extra lines, badges, proof claims, review stars, prices, discounts, or guarantees on the image.

VISUAL CHANGE 4:
Remove all competitor brand identity from the scene. Do not keep any competitor packaging identity, watermark, logo, tagline, or unique graphic marks. If image 2 contains the Plaid à Moi logo or legitimate brand mark on the product, it may appear naturally only as part of the product identity. Do not invent a separate logo placement unless it already exists in the original structure.

CLAIM CONTROL:
Do not show any numbers, ratings, review counts, studies, certifications, medical claims, clinical claims, or proof statements. Do not claim that children love the product as a verified fact. Do not include phrases such as clinically proven, best seller, number one, thousands of customers, customer favorite, or guaranteed happiness. The final image should communicate the benefit visually: each child has their own personalized blanket with their own name and color.

DEMONSTRATION VISUAL DISCIPLINE:
This is a staged demonstration scene, not a real customer testimonial. Do not make it look like UGC proof, do not add testimonial quote marks, do not add review UI, and do not imply the children are real buyers or verified customer results.

DO NOT INVENT:
Do not add badges, review stars, price tags, CTA buttons, discount labels, countdown timers, shipping claims, guarantee seals, extra products, floating icons, extra children, pets, gift boxes as promotional callouts, cards, borders, banners, or decorative graphics that are not present in image 1. Match the original element count: one headline text box, four children, four personalized blankets, one cozy living room background.

FINAL CHECK:
The final creative must preserve the original composition and emotional hook while replacing competitor text and product identity with Plaid à Moi. The ad must feel warm, believable, cozy, and conversion-focused for French-speaking parents and grandparents. No watermarks. No competitor brand marks. Photorealistic. No stylization.

pubs.consigne: plaid plié dans une pochette cadeau avec étiquette Plaid à Moi

plan.idee: Une mise en scène cadeau rend immédiatement visible l’idée forte du produit : un plaid personnalisé qui paraît pensé pour un enfant précis, pas une couverture générique.
plan.accroche: Son prénom. Sa couleur. Son plaid à lui.
textesVisibles: Son prénom. Sa couleur. Son plaid à lui.
plan.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 4:5 vertical product ad for the brand Plaid à Moi.

Using image 1 as the product and brand identity reference. Preserve the brand identity from image 1: logo style, color feeling, product finish, textile look, personalization style, and any visible product design details.

SCENE STRUCTURE: A folded personalized children’s plaid blanket sits neatly inside a soft gift pouch on a clean studio surface. The pouch is slightly open so the folded plaid is visible. The plaid should show a personalized first name clearly embroidered or printed on the visible fold: "LÉA". Add a small hanging gift tag attached to the pouch with the brand name "Plaid à Moi". The scene should feel warm, simple, giftable, and parent friendly, not luxury, not babyish.

COMPOSITION: Center the pouch and folded plaid as the hero object, shot from a slightly elevated front angle. Keep generous negative space above for the headline and a small call to action button near the bottom. Use a clean 4:5 social ad layout with balanced spacing. The product should occupy the lower central half of the frame, large enough to show the fabric texture and personalization.

PRODUCT LOCK: The plaid and brand identity must match image 1 as closely as possible. Do not redesign the product, do not invent a different logo, do not change the textile finish, and do not alter the core product appearance. If image 1 shows a specific plaid color, pattern, label, or logo placement, keep it consistent. The personalization must look naturally integrated into the plaid, not pasted on.

BRAND SURFACES: Use Plaid à Moi colors around the product. Background should be mostly warm white #FFFFFF with a very soft surface tint #F3F6FF. Use deep text color #17151F. Add small accents in #00A7B5 and a rounded CTA button in #5B2EFF. Keep a 60-30-10 balance: mostly white and soft surface tones, secondary dark text, small turquoise and purple accents.

TEXT LOCK: Add only these readable French text elements:
1. Headline at the top: "Son prénom. Sa couleur. Son plaid à lui."
2. Gift tag text on the pouch: "Plaid à Moi"
3. Personalized name on the folded plaid: "LÉA"
4. CTA button near the bottom: "Personnaliser le sien"

TYPOGRAPHY: Use a clean, rounded sans serif type style. The headline should be large, warm, and easy to read. The CTA button should be clear and simple. Do not add prices, ratings, reviews, certifications, medical claims, proof claims, shipping claims, or extra numbers.

LIGHTING: Soft natural studio lighting from the upper left, gentle shadows under the pouch, cozy but crisp product photography. Fabric texture should look soft and tactile. The pouch should feel like a simple gift pouch, not a premium luxury box.

STYLE: Photorealistic product photography, polished ecommerce ad, minimal props. No people. No customer result implication. No before and after. No watermarks. No competitor brand marks. Photorealistic. No stylization.

pubs.consigne: angle fratrie : chacun son plaid, plus de chicane sur le divan ; pas d enfant reconnaissable en gros plan

plan.idee: Montrer deux enfants vus de dos, chacun dans son plaid personnalisé prénom + couleur, transforme instantanément la chicane de divan en solution visuelle simple et familiale.
plan.accroche: Chacun son plaid. Moins de chicane sur le divan.
textesVisibles: Chacun son plaid. Moins de chicane sur le divan.
plan.prompt:
Using reference image #1 as the product and brand identity reference for Plaid à Moi. Create a 4:5 vertical Meta/TikTok ad creative, photorealistic, warm family lifestyle style.

Product lock: if the reference shows the plaid, it must match the product style, material, colors, proportions, and branding cues from reference image #1. If the reference shows the logo/brand only, use the brand colors and keep the product as soft personalized children’s throw blankets.

Scene: a cozy living room sofa in a real family home. Two children sit side by side on the couch watching TV, shown from behind or with faces fully turned away so no child is recognizable. Each child has their own personalized plaid: one teal/blue blanket with the name “NOAH”, one soft pink/coral blanket with the name “LÉA”. The names should look like part of the blanket personalization, large and readable near the lower fold. Between them, a plain generic grey blanket is crumpled on the floor, suggesting the old shared-blanket problem is over.

Composition: wide enough to show both children from the back, both blankets, and the sofa. Make the two personalized plaids the visual focus. Add a subtle peaceful contrast: kids relaxed, no arguing, each in their own cozy cocoon.

Lighting and camera: natural late-afternoon window light, handheld iPhone feel, slightly warm, authentic, not polished studio. Eye-level camera from behind the couch, shallow depth of field but all text readable.

On-image text overlay: top center, bold rounded sans-serif, dark #17151F on a soft white rounded rectangle: “Chacun son plaid. Moins de chicane sur le divan.” Bottom center button in brand purple #5B2EFF with white bold sans-serif text: “Choisir les prénoms”.

Constraints: no close-up recognizable child faces, no testimonials, no star ratings, no review counts, no medical claims, no certifications, no invented badges, no pricing, no extra numbers, no extra readable text beyond the specified words, no watermark, no fake logos. This is a staged demonstration visual, not a real customer result.
